name: Mandapam Trawler Heading toward Sri Lanka IMBL
description: Vessel leaves Mandapam port and moves eastward across Palk Bay, triggering Advisory (10nm), Alert (5nm), and Critical (2nm) IMBL geofence warnings.

waypoints.note: Cruising east in Indian territorial waters
Approaching IMBL 10 nm buffer — Advisory Tier
Inside 5 nm Alert zone — Warning to turn back
CRITICAL: 1.2 nm from Sri Lanka IMBL — Turn-back heading 265° recommended
